evidence: Pass for the row 39 reason-through/source-design check; this is not a measured configured-judge score. Frozen workbook Quality Checks row 40 (quality check 39) and skill quality-checks.md:161-163 require reasoning through floor submissions. Blank/static login/workspace pictures fail tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23. A polished seed-copy, keyword-stuffed mock, all-actions-refused app, or no-op HTTP 200 create cannot satisfy tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-25: create a uniquely named requisition AND a new PENDING offer through UI, then retrieve exact identities, association and entered values from an independent empty signed-in context. A localStorage-only imitation fails the separate context; a requisition-only implementation lacks the required offer. The gate explicitly rejects these cases and does not trust health/static responses. All three scored prompts independently restate a new-record/shared-storage test (functional:9-11; polish:7-8; visual:7-8), with binary 0 or normalized-zero raw Likert 1 for observed dead-app failure. Submission instructions are untrusted (each prompt opening), so keywords or reward claims are not evidence. tests/test.sh:212-227 runs and aggregates gates before scoring; score.py:40-48 makes either failed gate zero every scored dimension and final reward, and prevents zero-functional apps farming polish/visual. Frozen scoring policy and score.py match the frozen template byte-for-byte. Concrete broken witness: indexed local/gate-witness.cjs:10 injects a no-op requisition response; results.json:27-34 records HTTP 200 but no saved/fresh requisition or offer and basic_gate_observations_satisfied=false. The golden and deliberately dead-approval variants retain true basic intake observations (same results:5-24), showing later incomplete features are not incorrectly imposed by the minimum gate. Artifact hashes were recomputed: driver 08ee689584d24a97a8446fb32ca0c4f9d3df100bd6eec14560c4fa63ad8ae31c; results fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75. The local MCP observation also proves newContext with separate UI login/readback; its indexed hash 48a0cd895038166f56e2e0998a00eccdcc671cd8842b4dca468f7b8df9c8013f and all 13 reference source hashes match this snapshot. Conforming alternative considered: an initially empty operational desk with generated IDs, no separate title/department controls, equivalent money/date display and CDN assets. instruction.md:9-11 permits these; constraints criterion:23-25 and app_context.md:21-27 accept them and require only product-intent discovery, so none is a reason to impose the dead-app floor. Independent Python -B execution of unchanged score.py with explicit synthetic numeric fixtures is saved at per-row-review/evidence/39/aggregator-results.json (SHA256 a27bf20a97d72afc0915102f1d37c0203b867318f41e53d7295bcae86ef91029): failed render, failed constraints and both-failed produce reward 0 with exit 1 even when all scored fixture dimensions equal 1; functional 0 and exact 0.05 produce reward 0; a 0.5 working fixture produces 0.5. These are aggregator branch tests, not app grades. Indexed artifact verification is recorded in evidence/39/verified-evidence.json. Full configured judge floor outcomes remain unmeasured, as stated by the index; no Oracle/model/portal score or overall runtime clearance is claimed or waived by this source-design Pass.
